title: PCSO Lotto Results: No winners of P549-M Ultra Lotto jackpot on Tuesday, November 17
summary: There were no winners of the nearly P550 million Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot drawn by the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) on Tuesday, November 17, 2026.

blocks.text: There were no winners of the nearly P550 million Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot drawn by the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) on Tuesday, November 17, 2026.
The Ultra Lotto 6/58 prize was pegged at P549,576,298.64. The winning numbers were 51-56-30-20-29-34.
The last time a winner was drawn for Ultra Lotto was on May 5, 2026 when 10 bettors correctly guessed the winning combination and shared the P76,305,973.15 prize.
On March 17, a senior citizen who played lotto for the past 25 years became the sole winner of the Ultra Lotto jackpot of P100.331 million.
Winners also remained elusive for Superlotto 6/49 bettors after no one chose the combination of 07-49-42-38-10-31 that would have yielded the P114,215,480.54 jackpot.
No one also guessed the correct combination for Lotto 6/42 which was 16-28-35-29-31-36. A lucky bettor would have won the jackpot of P23,013,429.70.
